items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: And there was Sidney Catlett, he played on the boat, there was Louie Metcalf, Fate Marable, he was playing with Charlie Creath at the time.

ctx.x: Yes. They all used to play on the boat with Charlie Creath, you see. They played on the boat with Charlie Creath, which was the best job you could get in the season. And there was Sidney Catlett, he played on the boat, there was Louie Metcalf, Fate Marable, he was playing with Charlie Creath at the time. Later on he became a bandleader himself.
Where did Sidney Catlett come from?
